# GPU_Hegemony_Disruption

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The strategic shift away from NVIDIA's universal GPU architecture toward domain-specific ASIC ecosystems with tailored interconnect topologies. Opens opportunities for TCC to propose novel network-centric compute models that outperform general-purpose accelerators in specialized AI workloads.
